question: Why did Runway clips in this repo look worse than clips made in the old lab on 2026-11-10 06:30–12:00 CET?
answer: The provider, key, model (wan3), ratio and request fields were identical. The method differed: the old lab ordered one action per clip between two real video frames; this repo ordered a whole deal-and-return in one 12 s clip whose last image was the start pose with a painted card.

basis.verified: Archived plans, receipts, start/end images and decoded frames read on 2026-11-10; batch results below reviewed frame by frame.
basis.inferred: That clip structure and end-image meaning are the cause. Sampling variance is real: byte-identical inputs gave an edge passage once and a colour morph once.

methodDifferences.thisRepoBefore: Take, turn, land, return and hold in one 12 s clip

findings.statement: The raised-hand return in the old bank was requested: the prompt says to maintain height and travel in one high arc, and the return started at deal frame 93 where the hand was already raised.
With a hover-after-release end image the deal finishes at 2.6 s and the model fills the rest with a lift to the chest and back.
The old bank put every player card at y 1029–1045; the saved plan is an arc. No old deal lands within 14 px of the plan; P7 is 130–143 px off.
The covered start (card fully inside the shoe) was ordered in the old lab and listed as missing. READY2 was an image-generated attempt and is not user accepted.
kling_4 accepts first, up to eight middle and last images on /v1/image_to_video. The earlier contract dismissed it only because audio cannot be disabled. Not tested here.

userReview20261110.source: Jakob in chat after viewing the local comparison page

ratings.v6-native-reference: 4/5, beautiful and turns the card, but changes hands
ratings.pamela-sequence-17-native-r2: 2.5/5, some one-hand turns, feels unnatural, P1 and P7 land in odd places
ratings.pamela-older-14-mask-refined: 3/5, best-looking whole sequence, but no closed-to-open turn and P1/P7 placement wrong
ratings.pamela-p4-c1-source-turn: 4.5/5, nothing major except no return to READY

userReview20261110.alsoStated: Wants two cards to each player and two to the dealer, separate returns from each card to IDLE, and remembers the slower tempo as better.

observed.pamela-p4-c1-deal-calm-01: Same left hand. Yellow narrows f67–70, thin edge f71–72, blue opens f73–80 with no one-frame snap. Flat on the table f96, index fingertip on the corner f96–114, release f115–117. No gesture after release.
observed.pamela-p4-c1-return-ready-calm-01: Index fingertip re-touches the card f6–18, lifts f21–24, travels at shoe-top height with a loose fist, pinch at the shoe f54–57 and holds.
observed.pamela-p4-c1-return-idle-calm-01: Same re-touch f6–18, then straight back to both hands resting by f42 and holds.

seams.deal f119 → return f0: 33 pixels over threshold at quarter size, but a double touch
seams.deal f110 → return f7: one touch and one release; about 600 pixels over threshold

batch1.limits: One take each. The card lands at the old P4 position, 63 px from the plan. Not user reviewed yet.

landingMethod: blue mask B>90, B>1.5R, B>1.15G at the bank release frame; largest blob not already measured
